pythonFunction.name: get_auth_options
pythonFunction.description:
Returns which Tier 2 verification methods exist for the identified account. Must be called
before any validate tool; only the methods it allows may be offered. Before calling this tool,
speak a brief conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Account id from the identified account (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, ssn_tax_flag (SSN or TAXID, empty when not on file), pin_set and cc_on_file.
    Never contains any secret value.
